model.title: Proposal for a COUNCIL REGULATION amending Regulations (EU) No 1380/2013, (EU) No 1308/2013, (EU) 2023/1115 and (EU) 2024/1348 of the European Parliament and of the Council, and Council Regulation (EU) 2023/2720 as regards adaptation of certain requirements and reduction of administrative burden in the Union outermost regions

summary.text: This proposal aims to simplify rules and reduce paperwork for the EU's outermost regions by modifying regulations that cover fishing, agriculture, trade, and related administrative requirements.
